sections.title: Introduction to International Development
sections.description: For 75 years, international development policy and programs have shaped flows of money, people, and ideas across the Global South as globalization, urbanization, and cross border migration have occurred. This course examines development theories, institutions, and practices, with a focus on urban issues. It explores who defines, funds, and practices development; what it covers; and how it is measured, referencing such contemporary global frameworks as the 2030 Agenda and SDGs, Paris Agreement, New Urban Agenda, Convention on Biological Diversity, and Sevilla Commitment.
